name: docflow
description: From an idea to merged code through a fixed chain of linked documents — PRD, architecture, specifications, tasks and a CLAUDE.md block — each written by one command and approved at a checkpoint, optionally translated section by section; then the plan is implemented task by task or sprint by sprint, on its own branch, with the project's checks, a ticked TASKS.md and a draft pull request. Scripts do the mechanical work; the model only writes.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin: en (English), fr (Français), es (Español), de (Deutsch).

doc_languages.title: Document translations
doc_languages.description: Translations written next to each English document, comma-separated: fr, es, de (docs/PRD-FR.md…). Empty: none. Only changed sections are translated again.

unit.title: Unit of work
unit.description: What /docflow:do next takes: sprint (every task of the current sprint, then its acceptance test, on one branch) or task (the first unticked task).

implementer.title: Implementer
implementer.description: Who writes the code: session (the current session — fewest tokens, the code read stays loaded), task (one fresh agent per task) or sprint (one agent per sprint).

worktree.title: Worktree
worktree.description: on: each run gets its own worktree next to the repository, your checkout does not move. off: the branch is created in your checkout (tracked files clean), which goes back to its branch after the pull request.

issues.title: GitHub issues
issues.description: mirror: /docflow:issues push mirrors each unticked task as a GitHub issue (deduplicated, readable by the tracker plugin) and pull requests close them. off: TASKS.md only.

checks.title: Checks command
checks.description: Shell command that must pass after each task (cargo test --locked, npm test…). Empty: detected from the project (Cargo.toml, package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod), else asked once.

branch_prefix.title: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: Prefix of the run branches, ending with / (docflow/S2-placement).

writer_model.title: Model — writer
writer_model.description: Model of the writer agent: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: inherit.

writer_effort.title: Effort — writer
writer_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the writer agent: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: inherit.

translator_model.title: Model — translator
translator_model.description: Model of the translator agent: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: haiku.

translator_effort.title: Effort — translator
translator_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the translator agent: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: inherit.

implementer_model.title: Model — implementer
implementer_model.description: Model of the implementer agent: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: inherit.

implementer_effort.title: Effort — implementer
implementer_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the implementer agent: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: inherit.

acceptance_model.title: Model — acceptance
acceptance_model.description: Model of the acceptance agent: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: sonnet.

acceptance_effort.title: Effort — acceptance
acceptance_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the acceptance agent: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: inherit.
